proposed_capability: MoonWake Closers P83/P03/P141/P124 correction of merged experience-memory lost-update race: recheck under bounded exclusive filesystem lock before writing genuinely new semantic experience, preserve byte-identical no-write behavior on familiar memories, deterministic conflict and concurrent-writer abstention.
operator_correction: Previously completed vanilla and modified preference trials remain learned past experiences and must never trigger Sims restart to reconstruct knowledge. Store only new experiences; existing experiences return read-only. Multiple agents must not erase one another's learned new outcomes.
player_save_control_impact: Lock only the explicit repository-owned ignored experience index when a distinct new fact requires writing. No game restart, game process access, personal file profile, network, Windows input, save mutation, mod installation, unattended monitor, or new alternative memory owner. Known entries are read-only without acquiring the lock or changing files.
expected_outcome: On contested new inserts, one process obtains atomic local lock and re-reads latest memory under it; no stale read overwrites distinct previously written events. Busy lock yields explicit finite HOLD without mutation. Familiar/contradicting events return without disk writes. A crash-lock is preserved for safe inspection instead of forcing cleanup.
negative_tests: Two independent new experiences interleaving around initial stale read are both retained after locked recheck
Already known event does not create lock file, change bytes or mtime
Second writer sees busy lock and fails without overwriting committed data
Concurrent identical new result rechecks into ALREADY_KNOWN without another data rewrite
Crash/foreign writer lock never stolen or unlinked by another process
Version and profile isolation, conflict preservation, provenance, privacy and player-first unaffected
No agent restarts Sims, manufactures game state, or promotes offline tests into live cert
rollback_path: Revert isolated source/tests/contract change with no effect to previously persisted experience data or Sims installation; no schema migration needed and original memory JSON stays compatible.
unresolved_unknowns: Windows-local installation state and already-captured native preference receipts are not available through GitHub connector and require separate exact host readback, not another game trial.
Local MoonWake full stage-walker and other agents are not launched from this remote GitHub provider; status must distinguish connector operations from host dispatch.
